question: Can the controller supply dated official provider documentation excerpts in the snapshot covering all ten accepted models’ canonical IDs, lifecycle, effort values, omitted/none semantics, tool compatibility, native request and response formats, streaming, and access prerequisites? The supplied sources do not establish the mandatory Stage 8 matrix.
technical:
Stage 8 is blocked by the evidence prerequisite in AC-817-01 and BDD-817-13. This is a blocker report, not a complete technical specification or Ready for Build recommendation.

Verified source revision: 9f345ff02cb94855a5e7b17e1433669d7aa9643c. In src/agents/model_catalog.rs, catalog() includes claude-haiku-4-5, but ModelCatalogEntry and ModelCatalogDocumentEntry contain Boolean reasoning preferences rather than effort/API mappings. Existing catalog membership does not establish official effort support. LlmProvider in src/agents/mod.rs has no effort argument. OpenAiClient in src/agents/openai.rs constructs Chat Completions requests without an explicit reasoning-effort field. AnthropicClient in src/agents/anthropic.rs uses Messages without effort input. GrokClient in src/agents/grok.rs delegates to OpenAiClient; create_provider_with_api_key in src/agents/factory.rs also shares that implementation across other providers.

The retained docs/e2e/results/duumbi-780-completion-20260910/live-provider-error.json records one gpt-5.6-luna rejection. It does not establish successful Responses behavior, supported effort values, or capabilities of the other models. planning/Duumbi/05 Archive/Processed Inbox/2026-09-12 - Provider Models and Reasoning Effort Support.md supplies requirements and historical interpretation. The provider endpoint references in planning/Duumbi/02 Resources (Assets and Tools)/Sources (References)/duumbi-loop-codex-task.md do not supply the required documentation contents.

Official matrix evidence remains unresolved for GPT-5.6 Luna, Terra, and Sol; GPT-6 Astra; Claude Sonnet 5, Opus 5, Haiku 4.5, and Fable 5.1; and Grok 4.6 and Build 0.1. Unknown evidence must not be classified as documented unsupported behavior. Canonical IDs, mappings, response contracts, and verification dates cannot be inferred from display names, catalog preference flags, or the historical error.

The proposed work retains the approved single unit provider-reasoning-compatibility, with no child dependencies. It owns AC-817-01 through AC-817-08, BDD-817-01 through BDD-817-13, and all integration evidence. Effort preservation and joint delivery remain fixed. No substitution, downgrade, or phased release is proposed.

After the evidence is supplied, Stage 8 must complete the matrix and dependent adapter design, catalog migration, endpoint descriptor, test mapping, and bounded Ralph/live-validation plan. These cannot be deferred to implementation research. No files were changed, external services called, or tests executed.
